items.summary: Caleb Martin’s first full season with the Mavericks was disappointing, but he has emerged as a valuable three-and-D wing this year, writes Eddie Sefko of NBA.com. After being limited to 58 games last season by back, heel and ankle injuries, along with an extended illness, Martin is back to full health and looks more like the player he was earlier in his career. “He’s just comfortable,” P.J. Washington said. “Last year, he was dealing with injuries. This year, he’s more back to himself, finding a rhythm. We love him being out there doing whatever he wants on the defensive end. items.title: LeBron James records first triple-double with 76ers: Where he ranks on all-time list
items.summary: In case you forgot, LeBron James is great.The NBA's all-time leading scorer notched his first triple-double with the Philadelphia 76ers Wednesday, Nov. 25 in an NBA Cup matchup against the Miami Heat.He completed the feat with 1:43 left in the fourth quarter, when he scooped his 10th rebound. With Joel Embiid sidelined to start the game and Jaylen Brown getting banged up just seconds before the end of the first half, James took over. He erupted in the second quarter, burying 3-pointer after 3-pointer.James finished the game with 25 points on 9-of-15 shooting, adding 12 assists and those 10 rebounds.This is the 126th triple-double in James' career, which has now reached an NBA-record 24 seasons.
